name: Code Review Workflow
description: Analyze and review code from a git repository. Performs architectural analysis, code quality checks, security review, and generates a comprehensive report.

stages.name: Architecture Analysis
stages.description: Analyze the overall architecture and structure of the codebase

prompts.label: Analyze Architecture
prompts.text: Analyze the architecture of the codebase at {{repo_path_target}}. Focus on: {{review_focus}}. Examine the directory structure, module organization, dependency patterns, and design patterns used. Provide a detailed analysis.

stages.name: Code Quality Review
stages.description: Review code quality, patterns, and best practices

prompts.label: Review Code Quality
prompts.text: Review the code quality of the codebase at {{repo_path_target}}. Focus on {{review_focus}}. Check for: code duplication, naming conventions, error handling, testing coverage, documentation, and adherence to best practices. Language: {{language}}.

prompts.label: Security Analysis
prompts.text: Perform a security review of the codebase at {{repo_path_target}}. Check for common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), insecure configurations, dependency vulnerabilities, authentication/authorization issues, and data handling concerns.

stages.name: Review Report
stages.description: Generate comprehensive review report with recommendations

prompts.label: Generate Report
prompts.text:
Based on the architecture analysis, code quality review, and security review conducted above, generate a comprehensive code review report. Include:
1. Executive Summary
2. Architecture Assessment
3. Code Quality Findings
4. Security Findings
5. Prioritized Recommendations
6. Action Items

Format the report in markdown.

variables.name: git_url
variables.label: Repository URL
variables.description: HTTPS or SSH URL of the git repository to review

variables.name: review_focus
variables.label: Review Focus
variables.description: Specific areas or files to focus the review on

variables.name: language
variables.label: Primary Language
variables.description: Primary programming language of the codebase

rules.message: Review report should be at least 500 characters
